notes.title: 📢 Version 1.0.3 Update is Live! 📢
notes.notes:
Hey Mayhem Fans,

We're excited to announce that Multiplication Mayhem has just been updated to version 1.0.3, bringing some important bug fixes and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience! Thanks to all of your feedback, we've been hard at work polishing up the game to ensure it runs smoothly for everyone.

Here’s what’s new in this update:

🛠 Fixed a bug on the victory screen: We’ve resolved an issue where the game would hang when clicking the "Next Level" button after completing a level.
🛠 Level progression fix: The Seraphin Boss Level, which was skipped after Level 6, is now back in its rightful place. Get ready to face the challenge!
🛠 HUD fix: We've fixed an issue where the HUD wasn’t always displaying the correct number of puzzle steps, giving you more accurate feedback during gameplay.
🛠 Dialog adjustments: Heracles' dialogue has been trimmed and altered to better fit the game's progression, ensuring a smoother and more cohesive story experience.
As always, your feedback is invaluable, so please let us know if you encounter any more bugs or have suggestions. Thanks for being part of this journey and for all your continued support!

Happy gaming and good luck conquering those levels! 😊🎮

notes.title: Exciting Updates and New Release Date for Multiplication Mayhem!
notes.notes:
Exciting Updates and New Release Date for Multiplication Mayhem!

Hello Mayhem Enthusiasts!

We are thrilled to share some exciting updates about our game, Multiplication Mayhem! As we near the final stages of development, we wanted to give you a sneak peek at some of the stunning areas you'll be exploring.

The Azure Lakes:
This end-level is a beautiful area, featuring an intricate puzzle set against the backdrop of beautiful lake, island, and waterfalls, all enclosed by majestic hills. Check out the screenshots below to see the breath-taking scenery awaiting you.

Open Sky Throne Room:
A key turning point in our story, the Open Sky Throne Room offers a breath-taking sight of the sunset sky. This location is not just visually stunning but also pivotal to the unfolding narrative.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/81816a5fb35a162d70df55cb01eaaf6b7c2d8a14.png

Release Date Update:
To ensure we deliver the best possible experience, we've decided to move the release date by two weeks. You can find the new release date on our store page. We appreciate your understanding and patience as we fine-tune the game.

Demo Update 5:
We're excited to announce that Demo Update 5 was released during the Steam Next Fest! You can now try out the Temple of Prophecies level. Simply save your game and talk to Artemis the cat to unlock this new content.

For those who prefer a more guided experience, check out a non-commentated demo playthrough on YouTube: [previewyoutube=6usobMryupA;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your continued support! We can't wait for you to experience all that Multiplication Mayhem has to offer.

Stay tuned for more updates and happy gaming!

notes.title: 🎉 Exciting Demo Update 2!
notes.notes:
🚀 Update 2 is Live for Multiplication Mayhem!

Greetings, Mayhem enthusiasts! We're thrilled to announce that Update 2 has just rolled out on Steam. This update brings a host of exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here’s what’s new:

🐾 New Animal Buffs!
We've increased the number of animals you can save to seven, each bringing unique buffs to enhance your gameplay:

Kangaroo: High Jump
Rhino: Charge
Cat: Heal
Ostrich: Speed
Lion: Echoing Roar
Elephant: Memory Recall
Wolf: Howling Call

🔄 Revamped Animal/Buff Selector
Selecting your trio of animal allies is easier than ever with our new selector! Not only can you pick your favourites, but you can also dive into detailed descriptions and learn about the buffs each animal provides.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/bacedea101e8b847c89c7f9e97e91ccbc7920a1d.png

📖 Story and Dialog System
Dive deeper into the world of Multiplication Mayhem with our new dialog system. Experience the first few dialogs and uncover parts of our engaging story as you rescue animals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/8734254a12361916dd786bc680b941b17d4fcea9.png

🎮 Enhanced Menu System
We’ve reworked the menu to ensure a smoother, cleaner navigation experience. Issues with overlays are a thing of the past! Plus, pausing and switching controls are now more intuitive.

🛠️ General Fixes
We’ve also squashed several smaller bugs related to gameplay progression, visual glitches, and more.

We're committed to making Multiplication Mayhem the best experience possible and look forward to hearing your feedback on these new features. Save the animals and master multiplication with even more fun!

notes.title: 🚀 New Demo Update 1 Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, wonderful community!

We're thrilled to announce that Demo Update 1 for Multiplication Mayhem is now live on Steam! This update brings a host of exciting new features, improvements, and animals to enhance your gameplay experience. Your journey through the world of multiplication is about to get even more thrilling!

What's New:
Introducing the Buff/Animal Selector System: We've unveiled a brand-new feature that lets you select your companions and their buffs to aid you in your adventure. Choose from 7 unique animals, each bringing its own special buff to the gameplay. This update includes 4 fantastic new additions to our roster of animal allies.

Menu Enhancements: Navigation through menus has never been smoother, especially for those using controllers. We've streamlined the interface to ensure a seamless experience.

Feedback Form: Your thoughts and suggestions are invaluable to us. With the integration of a new feedback form, sharing your input is just a few clicks away.

Steam Overlay Integration: For those who've yet to add Multiplication Mayhem to their Wishlist, we've made it easier than ever. With a simple command, you can open the Steam overlay and wish-list the game right from within the demo.

Bug Fixes and More: We've squashed numerous bugs and fine-tuned the game's mechanics to ensure a smoother, more enjoyable experience for everyone.

Meet Your New Animal Allies and Their Buffs:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/83ea7c41340df8bfd5f2f604d1874a4cb9a53e5f.png

Krios the Kangaroo: High Jump 
Propel yourself to new heights and leap over obstacles with ease.

Ares the Rhino: Charge 
Bulldoze through platforms, clearing 3 incorrect answers in your path.

Artemis the Cat: Heal 
Gain a precious heart back, keeping you in the game longer.

Hermes the Ostrich: Speed 
Dash through levels with unparalleled swiftness.

Hercules the Lion: Echoing Roar 
Use this mighty roar as an echo locator, revealing paths and answers.

Mnemosyne the Elephant: Memory Recall 
Never forget a question or answer, displayed conveniently on the side of the screen.

Apollo the Wolf: Wolf Howling 
Clear the way by removing 6 false tiles and highlighting 3 potential correct answers.

We're incredibly excited for you to dive into these updates and enhancements. Your feedback is crucial to us, so please don't hesitate to use the new feedback form to share your thoughts and suggestions.

Ready to experience the mayhem? Check out the update here and see what adventures await you and your new animal allies in Multiplication Mayhem.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Let the mayhem multiply!

notes.title: Roadmap: Exciting Three-Wave Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Mayhem Masters!

We're thrilled to announce an exhilarating plan to bring a series of updates to Multiplication Mayhem Free Demo! Our team has been working tirelessly to enhance your experience, and we've decided to release these updates in three waves. This approach not only allows us to ensure each update is polished and bug-free but also means you'll get to enjoy new content sooner and in more manageable chunks.

Wave 1: Buffs and Animal Galore! 🐾

Release Timing: In just a few days!
What’s New: Introducing a brand-new Buff/Animal Selector System! Now, you'll have the power to choose from 7 unique animals/buffs, including 4 exciting new additions. We've also made significant improvements to menus, added a new feedback form, and integrated an easy way to open the Steam overlay to Wishlist Multiplication Mayhem if you haven't already.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/83ea7c41340df8bfd5f2f604d1874a4cb9a53e5f.png

Wave 2: Campsite Chronicles 🏕️

Coming Up Next: The campsite update will follow shortly after Wave 1. It introduces a freely explorable campsite area where you can interact with all the freed animals to dive deeper into the narrative story. It's a whole new way to experience the lore of Multiplication Mayhem, and it's almost ready for you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/4b65c6c07abf85dd67e2ce25e1c440b0e933b75b.png

Wave 3: Temple of Trials 🏛️

What to Expect: The third wave adds another layer of adventure with the ancient temple area, complete with a set of intriguing puzzles and key narrative progressions. This update will deepen the game's story and challenge your problem-solving skills like never before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/5c364c56500f2d2c679e0c81238b28a4324a277a.png

Looking Ahead: Beta Testing Sign-Ups

After the excitement of these three updates, our sights are set on the beta version of Multiplication Mayhem. We'll share details on how you can sign up to become a beta tester, offering you an exclusive glimpse into the future of the game and the opportunity to help shape its development.

Stay Tuned and Engaged

We're incredibly excited to bring these updates to you and can't wait for you to dive into all the new content. Your support and feedback have been instrumental in getting us this far, and we're eager to hear your thoughts on these upcoming additions.

Stay tuned to our Steam Community page for the latest news, and don't hesitate to share your excitement and feedback with us. Together, we're making Multiplication Mayhem not just a game, but an unforgettable adventure.

Thank you for being an essential part of this journey. Get ready for a mayhem-filled update experience like no other!

Warm regards,

The Multiplication Mayhem Team

notes.title: Discover Atheria's Magical Campsite in Our Upcoming Update!
notes.notes:
🌟 New Campsite Area Unveiled in Multiplication Mayhem's Upcoming Demo Update! 🌟

Hello, Aetheria Adventurers!

We're thrilled to announce an enchanting new addition to the world of Multiplication Mayhem - a mystical campsite area, set to debut in our soon-to-be-released demo update!

🌌 Explore the Wonders of a Floating Island
Step into a realm of wonder as you explore this fully explorable campsite, nestled on a beautiful floating island. The land is covered in a blanket of blue spore grass, with towering mushroom-like trees that create a magical biosphere. As night falls, the moonlight and a cosy campfire light up the area, offering a breath-taking view.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/2b7d82f25cfb5e9eb05b146690a961aff074f607.png

🐾 Meet the Spirit Animals and Luminaria the Fairy
This serene spot isn't just for relaxation; it's a hub for story progression and new adventures. Gather around the campfire to meet our spirit animals and Luminaria the fairy. Each character brings unique stories and quests, enriching your journey in Aetheria.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/e8044c266ddffe44ef2ce5c4136e165316975c94.png

💬 Engage in Visual Novel-Style Conversations
Dive deeper into the lore of Aetheria through visual novel-style interactions with the spirit animals and fairy NPCs. As we continue to add more dialogue options and cutscenes, your conversations will unlock new layers of the story.

🔍 Visit After Each Level for New Lore and Quests
Make sure to visit the campsite after completing levels to uncover more lore and receive side quests. Any spirit animal you free during your adventures will await you here, ready to share their wisdom and guide you further.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753739/3a3c28cc48fa1165746c717f39d3b6cb710bf2f1.png

🎮 Get Ready for an Immersive 3rd Person Experience
The campsite area introduces a 3rd person control scheme, allowing for a more immersive exploration experience. Traverse this unique environment and interact with its inhabitants like never before.

📣 Stay Tuned for the Demo Update!
We're putting the final touches on this update and can't wait for you to experience it. Keep an eye out for the future announcements!

Thank you for being a part of our community and for your continued support. We're excited for you to experience the new campsite area and all the wonders it holds.

Happy exploring!
KoryCode
